text:
maria_sales: Hey team — Orion Systems just sent back MSA/DPA redlines and a PO flow request. Key asks: customer-managed KMS/HSM language, EU data residency in the DPA, and an SLA bump to 99.9% for production. They also want DocuSign routed: procurement -> legal -> VP Ops. Can legal + ops triage and give timeline? I attached a short order form summary below.

maria_sales: Order form snippet:
```
Customer: Orion Systems
PO contact: procurement@orionsys.com
Signer: vp.ops@orionsys.com
Term: 12 mo (PO)
List price: $120k/year
PO net terms requested: Net45 (they asked)
Addendum: KMS/HSM requirement noted in redlines
```

devon_legal: Thanks, maria. Can you drop their redline PDF or paste the specific clauses? High level: liability cap increased, KMS/HSM addendum, and a restrictive DPA residency clause. Quick Q: are they asking for HSM-backed keys for hosted or for Dedicated? That affects our position.

maria_sales: Uploaded here: https://file.redwood/orion/redlines_v3.pdf. They said Dedicated for prod, but want to run the POC on hosted initially. They flagged KMS/HSM as a must for production. Procurement wants the DocuSign chain as above.

alyssa_finance: On the Net45 ask — standard is Net30. For enterprise we can consider Net45 after credit review. For the POC we typically invoice prepaid credits. If legal needs commercial concession to hit Net45, loop me in.

kevin_security: Quick take on KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated (integrations via customer KMS/CMK). HSM-backed attestations require an SOW and a short security validation window (we need keys transferred and audit proof). For hosted POC, we can offer platform-managed keys (SOC2 controls) but not customer HSM. Ask them to complete the 'Key Management' section of the security questionnaire and provide an architecture diagram showing where keys live and whether PII will be present in the POC.

ops_engineer: If they want Dedicated + customer KMS, provisioning + secure key handoff is 4–6 weeks (depends on networking/VPC). Hosted POC with psuedonymized data + prefix/KV caching profile can be ready in 3–5 business days. Also: Dedicated SLA = 99.9% (we can commit with Dedicated contract). Hosted SLA is 99.5%.

maria_sales: Thanks. @kevin_security can you draft a short paragraph I can send back on key mgmt and HSM expectations? Also confirm DocuSign routing is OK to hold until we finalize redlines.

signature_bot: Automated: DocuSign envelope template 'enterprise-po-v2' available. Confirm signers list and reply 'send' to deliver envelope.

devon_legal: DocuSign chain looks fine. We'll need to propose revisions: keep liability cap tied to fees, carve out gross negligence, and clarify DPA residency options (we can offer EU-only processing for Dedicated). If they insist on HSM language for Hosted, that's a blocker — we should push to SOW for HSM proof. I'll draft counterproposal and estimate EOD tomorrow.

kevin_security: Draft reply (copyable):
"We support customer-managed keys for Dedicated deployments; for Hosted we use platform-managed keys backed by SOC2 controls. HSM-backed attestation and on-site key custody require a scoped SOW and a key transfer window. Please provide an architecture diagram and confirm whether PII is in-scope for the POC so we can validate DPA controls and any additional encryption requirements."

alyssa_finance: :thumbsup: That draft works for budget conversations. On net terms: I'm OK escalating Net45 for full production with procurement approval; POC stays prepaid.

maria_sales: I'll send that to Orion now and ask for the diagram. I told them we'll propose an edited MSA and an addendum for key mgmt if needed. @ops_engineer please confirm the 4–6 week Dedicated lead for provisioning so I can quote them.

ops_engineer: Confirmed — 4–6 weeks typical. If they can accept a hosted POC first, that buys time to finalize Dedicated setup after PO. Also note: KMS integration requires customer IAM admin access during handoff window.

devon_legal: Draft counterproposal sent to legal@orionsys.com and cc maria_sales. Included: clarify liability cap, DPA residency options, and appended key management addendum that routes HSM requests to SOW. Also scheduled a 30-min review call Friday 10:00 AM PT — invite sent.

maria_sales: Got the draft. Sending invite to customer and procurement. I'll pause DocuSign 'send' until we have final signer list and counterparty acceptance.

signature_bot: Reminder: envelope 'enterprise-po-v2' status = pending. Will hold until manual 'send'.

maria_sales: Next steps summary: 1) I send kevin_security draft to customer and request diagram. 2) devon_legal will circulate final counterproposal and run the Friday review. 3) ops_engineer will provide final provisioning timeline and IAM checklist. 4) alyssa_finance to confirm net terms after procurement review. I'll update thread when customer responds. Thanks all.

devon_legal: Added a small warranty tweak and a carveout for security incidents related to customer-managed keys. If Orion pushes hard on Hosted HSM language we escalate to execs.

maria_sales: Noted. Closing loop here — I'll post their response in this thread.
